values.name: Individuation
values.definition: The pursuit of self-discovery, self-mastery, and purpose fulfilment.
observe: Made a choice that was clearly their own

values.name: Faith
values.definition: A deep belief in our roots — our ancestry, our heritage and the generations who came before us — and the confidence to build on them.
values.motto: Know where you come from. Build on it.
observe: Spoke about their family story or heritage with pride
Drew on their roots to make a hard choice

values.name: Diligence
values.definition: A consistent commitment to excellence, discipline, and productivity.
values.motto: Talent is cheap. Discipline is rare.
observe: Finished what they promised, on time

values.name: Accountability
values.definition: Ownership of actions, responsibilities, decisions, and outcomes.

values.name: Responsibility
values.definition: An active commitment to solving problems and advancing society.
values.motto: If you see it, own it.
observe: Took on a task without being asked

values.name: Cultural Appreciation
values.definition: Respecting, preserving, and advancing humanity’s diverse heritage.
values.motto: You cannot build the future if you are ashamed of your roots.
observe: Explained a tradition and what it teaches

values.name: Communal Spirit
values.transformation: I make myself useful to others
values.definition: Promoting cooperation, solidarity, collective prosperity, and cohesion.
values.motto: If your success ends with you, it is too small.
